title: Products
description: Register products and see each product's ad reviews.

filter.label: Filter by product type
filter.empty: No products of this type have been registered.

empty.title: No products yet.
empty.text: Add a product first. You can then review its ads as often as you need and keep every review in one place.

form.name: Product name
form.namePlaceholder: Product name as printed on the package
form.imageHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB. Used to recognize the product in lists.
form.removingBg: You can keep filling in the form while the background is removed. The first run takes longer while the AI model downloads.
form.removeBgFailed: Could not remove the background. Upload the original or choose another image.
form.removeBgNote: The background is removed inside this browser and the image is not sent anywhere else. The AI may cut parts of the product, so check the result before choosing.

detail.notFoundText: It was deleted or belongs to another company.

delete.confirmText: This deletes {name}. It cannot be undone.
delete.blockedText: Delete every review in this product before deleting the product.

errors.PRODUCT_NAME_TAKEN: A product with this name already exists.
errors.PRODUCT_NAME_TOO_LONG: Product names can be up to 200 characters.
errors.IMAGE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images can be uploaded.
errors.IMAGE_LIMIT_10_MIB: Images can be up to 10 MB.
errors.PRODUCT_HAS_REVIEWS: Delete every review in this product before deleting the product.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.note: Saved in this browser only. A draft disappears once its review starts.
drafts.deleteText: The saved ad and evidence files are deleted too.

evidence.title: Evidence documents
evidence.hint: Upload test reports to a product. The server reads each once and sorts out the issuer, code, version and the pages about this product. The same file is not read twice.
evidence.pickHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP · up to 25MB
evidence.reused: {name} was already read, so it was not read again.
evidence.readingBlocked: Evidence is being read. Ad reviews for this product cannot start until it finishes.
evidence.readingText: Reading the file. Scanned files can take a few minutes.
evidence.productNotFound: This product's name does not appear in the report
evidence.unread: Text on pages {pages} could not be read.
evidence.removeText: Deletes {name} and what was read from it.

failures.EVIDENCE_PAGE_LIMIT: The file has no pages or more than 80.
failures.PDF_OR_IMAGE_REQUIRED: Not a PDF or image file.
failures.EVIDENCE_READ_TIMEOUT: Reading took too long and stopped. Press Read again.
failures.EVIDENCE_READ_FAILED: The file could not be read. Press Read again.
failures.EVIDENCE_FILE_NOT_FOUND: The stored file was not found.
failures.READER_BUSY: The reading queue is full. Press Read again in a moment.
failures.READ_INTERRUPTED: The server stopped while reading. Press Read again.

errors.PDF_OR_IMAGE_REQUIRED: Only PDF, PNG, JPEG and WebP files can be uploaded.
errors.DOC_TYPE_TOO_LONG: The document type is too long.
